description: Use this first when the user describes what their business does, to find its insurance classification before suggesting coverages or estimating premiums. Pass only the business activity, for example 'bakery' or 'HVAC contractor'; leave out the business name, city and other details. Returns up to five candidate NAICS, ISO general liability and NCCI workers' comp code sets with a text-similarity score (not an underwriting confidence) and needsClarification. When needsClarification is true, ask the user which activity fits instead of choosing one.

business_description.description: The business activity only, e.g. 'bakery' or 'HVAC contractor'

state.description: Two-letter code of the US state where the business operates, not the user's current location

name: classify_business
title: Classify a business
